profile_text.body:
D-ID is an Israeli company that operates an AI-powered video creation platform, describing itself as a provider of digital human and avatar technology for businesses and individual content creators. Its core offering is the Creative Reality™ Studio, a self-service platform that combines deep-learning face animation, large language model text generation, and text-to-image capabilities to produce videos featuring talking and moving avatars. The company positions its technology as a lower-cost alternative to traditional video production, with features including voice cloning, multilingual output, and lip-syncing.

D-ID's platform targets use cases across marketing, sales, e-learning, and customer support, allowing users to build AI avatars for pre-recorded videos or deploy interactive AI Agents for real-time engagement. The platform integrates with third-party tools including Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, and Google Slides, and exposes an API for developers building their own avatar-based applications. The site lists Grupo Fórmula and its subsidiaries TVOAI and Radio Formula, as well as Pitango, among organizations that have used the technology, and notes G2 recognition for leadership, ease of setup, and performance.

The site also introduces a product called NUI, described as a Natural User Interface aimed at changing how people interact with digital systems using AI, though detailed specifications are not provided. The held facts classify D-ID's product under video generation and editing, noting associations with talking-head AI, photo animation, likeness rights, and deepfake risk. No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded for the company at this time.
